author: Ibrahim695
quote: OCARINA OF TIME (1998) — A TRUE MASTERPIECENow let’s talk about Ocarina of Time, released in 1998. This is what I call a true revolution in gaming. Real innovation, genuine artistic direction, an unforgettable atmosphere, an absolutely incredible soundtrack, actual dungeons, coherent physics, exceptional gameplay and a sense of freedom that genuinely made you want to explore.Memorable bosses, fascinating side quests, lovable characters, a beautiful story, a unique atmosphere, sadness, melancholy and an indescribable sense of nostalgia. Every location had a soul, every piece of music told a story, and every dungeon had its own identity. You actually felt something when playing it. It was **** imposed feminist ideology, no artificial relationships designed to provoke or normalize behaviours I do not agree with. Just an adventure, a story, emotion and a genuine artistic vision.Nothing like the direction GTA 6 is taking and the portrayal of America that I find deeply repulsive. The relationship between Jason and Lucia disgusts me, just like the universe and values portrayed throughout the game. I cannot identify with this vision of society, its consumerism or the constant presence of feminist **** honestly, how can anyone rank Rockstar above a masterpiece like Ocarina of Time? How can video game journalists place these productions on the same pedestal when they have absolutely nothing in common in terms of soul and identity?I am disgusted by gaming journalism, which sometimes seems to have forgotten what truly makes a video game great.Ocarina of Time has soul, identity, emotion and genuine artistic value. 1998 will always remind me of an era when video games had something truly magical. Now THAT is what I call a masterpiece.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Ibrahim695
quote: 13 years of waiting, only to end up with a woke, cucked and deeply disappointing game. Satanic rituals seem to be allowed in the game, yet the world’s oldest profession, prostitution, is nowhere to be found. Certain interactions are restricted: you cannot shoot certain NPCs, including in LGBT establishments or at protesters. More and more restrictions, but where has GTA’s freedom gone?There is no real revolution apart from the lighting, graphics and impressive draw distance. The NPCs, however, look and behave as if they came straight out of GTA 5. And it is not just the main characters who disgust me. Even the people surrounding them are repulsive. There are no values, no modesty and no sense of honour. Both the women and the men are portrayed in a way that I find absolutely disgusting.Jason disgusts me. He looks like a character with no soul, no modesty and no honour. Lucia disgusts me as well. We do not even understand why these two characters are together. Their relationship looks more like some strange open relationship than a genuine romantic relationship. There is no coherence, no commitment and no sense of family **** are being forced to play a couple that represents absolutely none of the values of a man and a woman who respect modesty, loyalty, their home and their children. Lucia left her son behind to go on a crime spree. She does not even seem genuinely attached to her role as a mother. Jason goes clubbing with his girlfriend, but apparently cheating on her is where the game draws the line! Constant contradictions in the writing and in the values the game seems to **** too much woke and feminist ideology. The whole thing feels like an attempt to normalize and promote a consumerist, corrupted, materialistic and morally bankrupt society. This is precisely the kind of societal model we are trying to distance ourselves from, not something we want to see celebrated in a video game.Even the physics are disappointing: place a car in front of a train and the train simply stops. Stand near an aircraft propeller or jet engine and nothing happens. Where is the realism we were promised?We were sold a revolution, but what I got was a game filled with restrictions, contradictions and ideological choices. No major gameplay innovations, just far more limitations than **** real fun, no major gameplay revolution, characters I cannot stand and an artistic and narrative direction that deeply disappoints me. I am extremely disappointed with the direction Rockstar has taken. I have even requested a refund from **** 6 was absolutely not what I expected after 13 years. A massive disappointment.
